7358.title: UI preference failure message scope
7358.rootCauseOneLine: The shared UI preference write-failure notifier hard-codes sidebar-specific copy for every synced preference key.
7358.proposedFix: Generalize the shared toast title to UI preferences and extend the existing failure test to verify a non-sidebar write's message alongside deduplication and retained local state.
7358.caveats: Deterministic sync-coordinator reproduction with SDK rejection; no live offline-browser test. The composer preference selects a plugin renderer, not an AI model provider.
